protocol.scenario_choice: largest pre-race 4-class RPCI probability (not user's manual selection)
protocol.axis: single AbilityTop3 x overallM3Top3 intersection; Ability rank1/2; win popularity1-6; proxy not exact Production
protocol.partner: predicted-scenario M4 rank<=3, Ability rank within upper 75% of field, main 1-4pop x 5+pop with wide lower odds>=5, fallback 1-4x1-4 with lower odds>=3, 5+axis chooses 1-4 partner
protocol.stake: fixed 1u, at most one ticket per race
protocol.return: final wide odds lower/upper as payout proxies, not actual settled payout or executable T-15 odds

caveats: Not actual manually chosen pre-race scenarios
M3, M4, and Ability were year-refitted proxies and do not exactly reproduce the app
Using final prices and wide ranges, not live bet snapshots or settled payouts
Alternative Ability thresholds inspected on same years; never select a Production rule based on them
One very large 133.8x wide quote dominates the 2025 success
decision: KEEP SHADOW; preregister and store real pre-race scenario choice and ticket odds before forward validation
